    {"name": "affected_system_scope", "analytical_usefulness": 0.75, "source_groundedness": 0.55, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Useful axis for locating burden.     {"name": "reassignment_indicator", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.2, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Reassignment is highly relevant as an operational burden affecting duration. However, the short_description/opened_at/closed_by text carries no evidence of reassignment; true/false values (403/97) appear invented and not derivable from the sampled source fields."},
    {"name": "recurrence_signal", "analytical_usefulness": 0.15, "source_groundedness": 0.1, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Near-constant (496 true / 4 false) so it offers almost no analytical leverage. Recurrence is also not derivable from a single row's terse text; the near-uniform 'true' appears fabricated."},
    {"name": "scope_indicator", "analytical_usefulness": 0.45, "source_groundedness": 0.4, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Individual vs system_wide is a useful burden axis, but largely redundant with affected_system_scope and weakly grounded: labeling WiFi/VPN issues 'individual' vs database 'individual' is inconsistent guesswork not clearly supported by text."},
    {"name": "time_of_day_band", "analytical_usefulness": 0.7, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Derived directly from opened_at timestamps, a legitimate axis for whether off-hours load drives duration. Mostly sound, though 7:34 labeled business_hours and 8:50 business_hours vs 18:14 after_hours are reasonable bandings."},
    {"name": "assigned_agent", "analytical_usefulness": 0.2, "source_groundedness": 0.15, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Largely redundant with existing assigned_to/closed_by columns. Values also contradict source: row 1 closed_by 'Fred Luddy' but sampled rows show assigned_agent differing from closed_by (e.g. VPN row assigned Beth Anglin while closed_by is Charlie), suggesting an ungrounded remapping."},
    {"name": "caller_segment", "analytical_usefulness": 0.2, "source_groundedness": 0.2, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Named a 'segment' but values are just individual caller names, offering little grouping leverage and duplicating caller_id. There is no caller field in the sampled source text, so the specific names appear ungrounded."}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.55,
  "source_groundedness": 0.45,
  "rationale": "Several columns give genuine axes for the 'operational burden vs duration' query: incident_category, failure_type, and time_of_day_band are both useful and well-grounded in short_description and opened_at. However a substantial subset is weak: recurrence_signal is near-constant and fabricated, reassignment_indicator asserts a fact the sampled text cannot support, assigned_agent and caller_segment are redundant restatements of existing columns and additionally contradict/lack source evidence, and scope_indicator overlaps affected_system_scope with shaky grounding. Overall the set offers moderate analytical leverage but notable hallucination in the process/behavioral columns drags groundedness below acceptable."
}
